# WO-136: i18n string inventory and Spanish glossary
Status: open (bulk backlog; Nora dispatches in her own order, WIP 5)
Vendor: codex
Agent: app-ui
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_CODEX.md)
Assigned to: Codex channel session (Nora dispatches)
Source: docs/BACKLOG.md CX-10, issued in CLAUDE-021

## Goal
Inventory every user-visible string in the wizard/dashboard templates and views (src/freemyid/wizard/) into docs/i18n/STRINGS.md (file:line, string, context, plural/variable notes). Then docs/i18n/GLOSSARY_ES.md: 60+ privacy and UI terms with a plain Latin-American Spanish rendering and a note on register (usted). No product edits.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Every factual statement about the product cites the source file:line it came from; nothing about features that are not on main.
- Plain words (target readers are older non-technical people for user docs; developers for dev docs).
- No real personal data; examples use Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths (no scratch, backup or .new/.tmp copies).

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- docs/i18n/STRINGS.md
- docs/i18n/GLOSSARY_ES.md
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
src/, every existing file not listed above, every other lane in docs/BACKLOG.md.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md when done; the team lead summarises in the channel.

## Notes and decisions (owner appends after each check-in)
- 2026-11-08 Morgan (CLAUDE-024): **text-only inventory exception approved.** Reading wizard/dashboard UI strings, including consent, practice-mode and sending/outbox screens, is allowed for STRINGS.md. "Reserved in-house" means in-house edits those files, not that their text is secret. Record each string with file:line and context. No edits to src/; copying the exact UI text into docs/i18n/STRINGS.md is the deliverable. Do not include code, logic or comments, only user-visible text.
